column2: Maricopa County official mayoral results for the five in-scope cities.
Source: elections.maricopa.gov Election Results Archives, per-year pages at
Retrieved 2026-09-16 through an authenticated browser session. The /asset/ paths
sit behind a Cloudflare bot challenge, so a plain fetch returns 403 and only a real
browser reaches them. The index pages themselves are server rendered and curl reads them.
Votes are citywide totals. Precinct level files are summed over all precincts;
summary files are read directly. Where both exist for one election they agree.
This file is raw evidence. It is not yet a coverage input. Winner and runner up
selection, the Arizona decisive primary rule, and no election years still need
the per city official mayor list.
